predicate.value: the evidence is absent, stale, malformed, mismatched, empty, unresolved, or outside the closed answer vocabulary

authorises.value: cite a recorded run only with its model, date, prompt-template digest, and corpus digest attached

boundary.value: The check proves neither agent routing nor corpus representativeness; a recorded score is never a gate and its prompt digest does not cover the whole agent context.

claim.value: The router-selection test establishes the closed corpus, source quotations, skill names, table coverage, declared pairs, and digest-bound run records.

evidence.value: closed source paths, canonical plugin skill names, recomputed corpus and prompt digests, hostile corpus guards, and zero command exit

recovery.value: Read the named failure, requote or retire the case rather than rewording the graded source, repair unresolved names, and regrade stale runs without editing their digest to agree.

refuses.value: Refuse malformed, incomplete, stale, unresolved, uncovered, unquoted, digest-mismatched, or unlisted corpus and run values.

statement.value: Accept router-selection evidence only after the closed corpus, source quotations, canonical skill names, coverage, pairs, and any recorded run all pass their declared checks.
